evidence.title: GitHub - stablyai/orca: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents.

name: Orca
summary: Open-source desktop app that runs many CLI coding agents in parallel, each in its own isolated git worktree.
description: Orca is an Agent Development Environment (ADE) for macOS, Windows and Linux with an iOS/Android companion app. It runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline or any other CLI agent side by side, each in its own git worktree, with Ghostty-class terminals, diff review and annotations, a per-worktree browser, Design Mode and a CLI in one app. Free and open source under MIT, with an enterprise offering.
contains: desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux plus iOS/Android companion (beta)
runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cline and any other CLI agent in parallel
each agent works in its own isolated git worktree
Ghostty-class terminals with WebGL rendering, splits and persistent scrollback
Design Mode sends a clicked element's HTML, CSS and screenshot to the agent
built-in diff review, GitHub and Linear items, Monaco editor and browser
MIT-licensed; enterprise plan with SOC 2 readiness and self-hosting
